backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile, fasting schedule, and nutrition tracking with role-based access control; stores user data keyed by Principal with CRUD operations for profiles, fasting windows, and daily nutrition entries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: applying modern color gradients to dashboard elements (FactorMarker, IntermittentFastingPanel, NutritionPanel) and ensuring gradient accessibility with sufficient contrast.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, hooks, utilities, and i18n setup; describes DNA helix theming, gradient styling, nutrition/fasting panels, and authentication flow.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS with OKLCH color system variables for light/dark modes, custom gradient utility classes for amber/sage card backgrounds, and base styling for the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with forced dark mode class and inline script to prevent light mode flash on initial page load.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component wrapping ThemeProvider, LanguageProvider, and Toaster; displays LoadingScreen with LivSpan token image during authentication/profile initialization, then renders StartDashboard.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component using Internet Identity; handles login/logout with gradient styling and loading states, clearing query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: Interactive health factor card with layered gradient backgrounds (amber for selected, sage for unselected), radial overlays for depth, hover effects, and connection line to DNA helix spine.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Fastin: Fasting schedule configuration component with hour selectors for start/end times, protocol display (e.g., 16:8), edit/save/cancel controls, and validation for minimum eating window duration.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: Dashboard panel displaying intermittent fasting status, timer, progress, and metrics (daily/weekly summaries, streak). Includes fasting schedule settings for authenticated users and uses custom hooks for schedule and timer management.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Nutrit: Dashboard panel for tracking nutrition metrics including body weight, protein intake, and vegetable consumption. Calculates BMI and protein targets, displays progress bars, and allows authenticated users to save daily nutrition entries.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: SVG-based animated DNA double helix background with gradients, glow filters, and connecting base pairs. Uses CSS animations for breathing and pulsing effects with motion-safe/reduce support.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: Container component rendering a vertical DNA helix spine with animated strands and connecting base pairs as a decorative background for child content.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: Button component for toggling between English and German languages, displaying current selection with visual highlighting.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: Gate component that prompts unauthenticated users to login and requires authenticated users to complete profile onboarding (name, birth year, height, gender) before accessing child content.
frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts: Centralized constant definitions for React Query cache keys covering user profile, fasting schedule, and nutrition queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingScheduleQue: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the user's fasting schedule, with toast notifications and automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: Custom hook that calculates and updates fasting/eating phase state every second, including elapsed/remaining time and progress percentage, supporting cross-midnight windows.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout, managing identity state and delegation validity with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's nutrition entry, with automatic cache invalidation and actor-dependent loading states.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfileQueries: React Query hooks for fetching and saving user profiles, implementing actor-dependent loading to prevent UI flashing during initialization.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: React context provider for managing language state (en/de) with localStorage persistence and browser language detection.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines TypeScript types and translation dictionaries for English and German, covering all UI strings for the application.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Custom hook to access the language context, providing current language, setter, and translations object.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light/dark mode palettes, including logo-inspired helix colors and sage/earth tones for natural theming.
frontend/src/lib/fastingMetrics.ts: Frontend-only utility functions that return mock fasting metrics (daily/weekly summaries and streak) for demo purposes.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionCalculations.t: Pure utility functions for nutrition calculations including BMI, protein targets, progress percentages, and safe number parsing with null handling.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionGuidance.ts: Analyzes macro distribution (protein, fat, carbs, calories) and returns deterministic guidance keys for i18n lookup based on nutritional balance patterns.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Shared utilities for formatting durations as HH:MM:SS and hours with decimal places for timer and KPI displays.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function combining clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional CSS class name composition.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point setting up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and rendering the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page with DNA helix background layers, factor selection spine, and panels for fasting and nutrition with language switching and authentication.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting hash-based routing with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup functions for sensitive parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme with custom colors (helix, sage palettes), DNA helix animations (breathe, pulse, glow), and font families.
project_state.json: Project state tracking modern gradient styling features applied to dashboard elements while preserving DNA helix background and ensuring accessibility.
